title: Use the reported English paper profile
instructions: Make all five decisions using only the current evidence-backed paper profile.

parts.prompt: Which timing statement matches the current reported profile?

options.text: One flexible 120-minute clock that covers every part of the paper together.
Section 1 is 90 minutes and Section 2 is a separate 30-minute composition period.
Every part, including composition, receives its own separate 30 minutes.
Only composition is timed.

parts.correct_explanation: The current evidence supports separate 90- and 30-minute periods.

parts.prompt: What makes the reported banked cloze distinctive?

options.text: A shared bank contains more words than gaps.
The learner writes without choices.
Every bank word must be used.
Every gap has a separate option list.

choice_rationales.A: This is the supported surplus-bank format.

parts.correct_explanation: Surplus choices require grammar and whole-text elimination.

parts.prompt: How does open cloze differ from banked cloze?

options.text: It tests only the spelling of words copied from the passage.
There is no bank, so the learner generates an exact fitting word.
Any synonym with a similar meaning is accepted as correct.
It is an interview.

choice_rationales.B: This is the defining response demand.

parts.hint: Ask whether the word is recognised or generated.

parts.prompt: Which description matches the reported reading component?

options.text: One memorised poem that is recited and then discussed.
Internet research.
A standalone editing passage in which errors are found and corrected.
Two passages with contextual synonym, reference and multiple-choice tasks.

choice_rationales.C: Editing is excluded from the current profile.

parts.correct_explanation: The present profile supports two comprehension passages and these operations.

parts.prompt: How should about 300 words be treated for composition practice?

options.text: As a confirmed automatic penalty boundary.
As provisional guidance until official confirmation.
As irrelevant to planning.
As permission to write without limit.

parts.correct_explanation: Approximately 300 words is a practice target, not yet a confirmed strict rule.
